summary: Campus access road where cars already park, backing onto university buildings and gardens.

best_section.where: Along the campus road beside the community garden, west of the lab buildings

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto university labs, a garden and bush; the nearest mapped dwellings are over 45 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed campus road with cars parked on the kerb, so there is room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet internal campus road, mostly daytime staff traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this stretch, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Campus road, may be patrolled or restricted
Steep stretch of road earlier at 20-60 m
sun_shade: Partly shaded by trees, mainly on the north and west sides.
